def f(I):
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    from collections import defaultdict
    g=defaultdict(list)
    for r,row in enumerate(I):
        for c,v in enumerate(row): g[v].append((r,c))
    for v,ps in g.items():
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        rs={p[0] for p in ps}; cs={p[1] for p in ps}
        if len(rs)==1:  # horizontal: connect extreme seeds, step 2
            ps.sort()
            for k in range(1,len(ps)):
                start=ps[k-1]; end=ps[k]
                s,e=start,end
                while (e[1]-s[1])>1:
                    cc=s[1]+2*(k)  # placeholder
                    break
                # simpler: iterate
                cur=(s[0],s[1]); sign=1
                tot=e[1]-s[1]
                step=2
                n=tot//step
                for i in range(1,n+1):
                    r_=cur[0]; c_=cur[1]+sign*i*step
                    out[r_][c_]=v
                    cur=(r_,c_)
        elif len(cs)==1:  # vertical, step 3
            ps.sort()
            cur=(ps[0][0],ps[0][1]); tot=ps[-1][0]-ps[0][0]; step=3
            n=tot//step
            for i in range(1,n+1):
                r_=cur[0]+i*step; c_=cur[1]
                out[r_][c_]=v
                cur=(r_,c_)
    return out

import json
def f(I):
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    from collections import defaultdict
    g=defaultdict(list)
    for r,row in enumerate(I):
        for c,v in enumerate(row): g[v].append((r,c))
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    for v,ps in g.items():
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        rs={p[0] for p in ps}; cs={p[1] for p in ps}
        pts=sorted(ps)
        if len(rs)==1:          # horizontal: connect extreme seeds, step2
            a=min(p[1] for p in pts); b=max(p[1] for p in pts)
            for i in range(1,(b-a)//2+1):
                cc=a+2*i
                if cc<b and 0<=cc<W and out[pts[0][0]][cc] in (8,7): out[pts[0][0]][cc]=v
        elif len(cs)==1:        # vertical: connect extreme seeds, step3
            a=min(p[0] for p in pts); b=max(p[0] for p in pts)
            for i in range(1,(b-a)//3+1):
                rr=a+3*i
                if rr<b and 0<=rr<H and out[rr][pts[0][1]] in (8,7): out[rr][pts[0][1]]=v
    return out
